profileSettings.label: Uses a LiteLLM gateway
profileSettings.hint: This profile's agent talks to a LiteLLM proxy: the statusline shows what you spent through it, and the LiteLLM window its figures.

profileSettings.label: Gateway URL
profileSettings.hint: The proxy's address, such as https://llm.example.com.

profileSettings.label: Access key
profileSettings.hint: A key of yours on the proxy. It reads your spend; it never leaves Mirador's host.

profileSettings.label: Month to date on the statusline
This conversation on the statusline
profileSettings.hint: What the conversation spent through the gateway, in place of the agent's own estimate, once the gateway logged a request of it.
